payload.title: feat/record 9f3434b8: the record on refs/hyp/record, keeping each copy of a bundle ref two clones pinned
payload.body: Commit 9f3434b on feat/record over 8d2cc8aa9096 (core.fsync for every record git run) over f296bc11b479 (h-record-4). hyp sync keeps a bundle both records hold at one path with other files whole on each side, the local copy at its path and the remote's under <lib>/.kept/<key>/<name>@<version>/; a write that pins such a copy keeps it there; questionable, hyp check and the uncontained check read a pin's bundle from the copy whose hash it names (limit R-BHDBGK#1). Each record git run sets core.fsync=objects,reference. It meets every line of G-SZCBXZ.

why: The successor of h-record-4 that closes its limit and carries the core.fsync commit.
Its title names commit 9f3434b8, a typo: the candidate is 9f3434b6b19b. A Hypothesis title cannot change, so a new Hypothesis replaces it before any tie or Experiment.

payload.title: Gate of h-record-5b: new tests red on the stand-in and green, removal checks, go test, import check, review
payload.body:
Gate of h-record-5b: commit 9f3434b6b19b on feat/record over 8d2cc8aa9096 over f296bc11b479 (h-record-4). Runs the case of every line G-SZCBXZ#1-#10 and of limit R-BHDBGK#1; applies answer R-BHDBGK#r1. Decided by reading the logs in this evidence folder.
1. New tests, run on the stand-in f296bc11b479 before this Experiment (standin-*.txt): TestSyncKeepsEachSidesPinnedBundle (#7, #5, R-BHDBGK#1) and TestRecordWriteHardensObjectsAndRef (none: a write is durable once it exits 0) red. On the candidate both green, and every new test of h-record-3 and -4 (TestOnlyRecordNamesTheFoldersAndRunsGit fails with the probe zz_boundary_probe.go) and the 11 line tests of h-record-2.
2. Removals, each alone: the patch applies whole, then the named test fails on an assertion; a build failure is a failed removal. r1 TestUnimportedWorkTreeStore; r2b TestRecordOutlivesEveryWorktreeAct; r3 TestAppendRefusesANamedFileNoOneHolds; r4, r5 TestSubjectCommitStaysReachable; r6 TestRecordRefusesEvidenceChangedDuringTheWrite; r7, r10 TestSyncKeepsEachSidesNamedBytes; r8, r9b TestBoundaryFindsEveryWayToRunGit; r11b TestBundleWithStoreInputKeepsItsHash; r12 TestSyncKeepsNamedFileShapedLikeAnEventsFile; r13, r14, r15 TestSyncKeepsEachSidesPinnedBundle; r16 TestRecordWriteHardensObjectsAndRef.
3. go vet ./... and go test ./... -count=1 exit 0 at the candidate.
4. Import check: as E-KCSN9Y step 4, at the candidate.
5. Line 7 reads as answer R-8ZKFQV#r1 (meaning 2). Answer R-BHDBGK#r1: line 4 is only about timing, so a refused write naming a held path with other bytes is out-of-Goal; TestReviewTwoWorktreesCiteOnePathAtOnce of E-KCSN9Y sets no verdict.
6. Review: one fresh subagent reviews git show 8d2cc8aa9096 9f3434b6b19b with the brief of E-KCSN9Y but those commits, R-BHDBGK#r1 added to the settled keys; it returns each finding as a test with its output. A returned test that is a case of a line and red on the candidate contradicts h-record-5b.
Verdict: supports when 1-6 hold; else contradicts.

why: The gate of h-record-5b, its rubric fixed before any gate run.

payload.observation: Gate of 9f3434b6b19b: TestSyncKeepsEachSidesPinnedBundle and TestRecordWriteHardensObjectsAndRef are red on f296bc11b479 and green here; earlier new and line tests stay green; the line-10 test fails with the probe. Removals r1-r14, r16 fail their test on an assertion; r15 applies whole but its test passes, a failed removal. go vet and go test ./... pass. Import check: renders equal, second import adds nothing. Review: TestReviewShowBundleEvidenceAfterSync (#1) and TestReviewPinnedBundleAtTwoLibraryLevels (#7) are red.
limits: Two clones each pin kit@1 with their own bytes and each Result cites a file of it, such as recipes/kit@1/run.sh, as evidence; then each runs hyp sync, and hyp show prints that pointer in each clone.

Two worktrees of one record repository each pin one bundle ref with other bytes from another library level, such as s/recipes/kit@1 and recipes/kit@1, and each records a Result on it; hyp show prints each Result from both worktrees.
After hyp sync leaves the other clone's copy of kit@1 at its path, a clone adds a new Experiment that pins its own kit@1 and records a Result on it.

why: The gate and the review of h-record-5b ran; two returned tests that are cases of lines 1 and 7 are red, and removal r15 failed.
